'''Xerrol's Place''' was a nightclub located aboard the [[Kuari Princess/Legends|''Kuari Princess'']].<ref name="RPG" /> During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the [[Gliz/Legends|gliz]] band [[Graf-Spanners]] played at Xerrol's. The [[Bartender/Legends|bartender]] had eleven arms.<ref name="RM">[[Riders of the Maelstrom (adventure)|''Riders of the Maelstrom'']]</ref>
